'''Turol''' is a [[Aiel]] warrior of the [[Stone Dog]] society.

==Activities==
Turol informs [[Roidan]] and [[Sulin]] that [[Rand al'Thor]] is [[Traveling]] to battle with one of the [[Forsaken]]. He did not tell them that it was [[Rahvin]].{{ref/book|5|53}}
